As an Athletic Trainer I would recommend jog/runs at a 50-70% intensity for a minimum 30 minutes to 60 minutes a day. You can use variable hills for extra work or flat track. Make sure you get a good warm up and dynamic stretch prior and cool down after. Stick to a program. You don't have to run necessarily but if you do an activity that elevates your heart rate for extended periods of time you will be working on cardiovascular. Push mowing lawns at a faster pace, raking leaves, shoveling snow etc are other non running examples.
